caption:
Just moved to Miami and want to play? Join a team in 3 steps. ⚽️

1. Find adult clubs near you on Cancha, by league and city.
2. Ask the club about a training session or tryout night.
3. Show up, then show up again. Teams remember who comes back.

Send this to someone new in town 👇 Link in bio.

App screens show example openings, labeled as examples.
